baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence زَيَّنَ ... أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ is held together with وَكَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: An attractive presentation changes the felt value of intentional deeds; those deeds then turn their agents away from a traversable route even though inward discernment remains available. The capture occurs at practical selection and persistence, not necessarily at perception.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the active display or attribution of beauty, functioning here as altered appraisal rather than altered eyesight.
The branch supplies purposive action, locating the capture in chosen practice rather than in a bare proposition.
The branch includes both turning away and making another turn, providing the directional obstruction produced by the beautified practices.
The branch supplies an extended route that is actually traversed, making the loss one of direction and movement.
The branch supplies inward knowledge and verification, preserving genuine cognitive access alongside behavioral misdirection.

changed_reading.before: They failed because Satan made them ignorant of the right way.
changed_reading.after: They could retain insight while the attractiveness of their own purposive practices captured valuation and redirected conduct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَد تَبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَاكِنِهِمْ makes the dwellings the source from which something becomes manifest to the present addressees.
baseline_models.mechanism: Places once inhabited remain as material indices of an absent social order. Visibility is not merely asserted in speech: the habitation itself carries evidence, so settled space becomes a witness to the trajectory of its former inhabitants.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies emergence into visibility and clarity, making the site an evidentiary disclosure.
The branch supplies inhabited house and settled residence, giving the disclosure a material location.
The branch associates a dwelling with its household, allowing an empty place to index the people no longer occupying it.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings are incidental scenery attached to a report about past peoples.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings are a surviving material witness from which the addressees can reconstruct the inhabitants' outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse moves from تَبَيَّنَ لَكُم to the past-state clause وَكَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two observing positions are staged across time: the present audience sees evidence in the former inhabitants' places, while those inhabitants themselves once possessed sight or insight. The former observers have become the absent object read through their dwellings.

activation_trace.role: The branch gives the current audience a disclosed object of attention.
The household sense lets places stand metonymically for the earlier human observers.
The branch supplies a state located in past time, separating their former discernment from the audience's present viewing.
The eyesight branch keeps a visual undertone alive within the stronger sense of reflective discernment.

changed_reading.before: The audience sees ruins, and the former peoples happened also to be intelligent.
changed_reading.after: The verse reverses observer and observed: people who once saw are now legible only through the places from which later viewers learn.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence treats pressure as an assay, then depicts evildoers calculating that they can get ahead and condemns their judgment. This sharpens beautification into a failure of practical appraisal exposed under test: sight can remain while estimation, choice, and consequence-tracking fail.

activation_trace.role: Inward verification is the retained capacity whose practical force is being tested.
The branch supplies the assay of metal or person, casting pressure as disclosure of operative quality.
The branch supplies supposition or reckoning, locating the defect in an evaluative calculation.
The branch supplies escape beyond a pursuer, giving the mistaken calculation its imagined outcome.
The branch supplies knowledge that judges aptly, the standard against which their appraisal is declared bad.

structural_cues: 29:2-4 move from an untested verbal claim, through assay, to people doing evils while calculating that they can outrun consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, supposition, attempted escape, and bad judgment; I infer that adornment corrupts practical appraisal rather than erasing sight. A live alternative is that these are parallel culpable failures rather than one cognitive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The final claim that they were discerning is an unexplained paradox.
changed_reading.after: Their discernment is precisely what pressure assays: available insight can lose control of judgment when attractive practices promise escape from consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rival route is marketed through direct speech: follow our way, and we will carry your liabilities. The promise beautifies the detour by seeming to transfer its moral cost, while the following verse restores the burdens to the recruiters and exposes the promise as false.

activation_trace.role: Displayed attractiveness anchors the sales-like reframing of culpable action.
Causing another to turn supplies the focus verse's socially distributable obstruction.
The branch supplies following behind another, making recruitment into the alternate route concrete.
The same traversable-route image labels the recruiters' possessive claim of our way.
The branch supplies bearing a trust or culpable load, which the speakers falsely offer to assume.
The contradiction of truth punctures the apparent safety used to beautify the detour.

structural_cues: 29:12 places route choice and promised liability transfer in one quotation; 29:13 reverses the offer into additional burdens and future questioning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recruitment, a possessed route, promised burden-transfer, and its falsification; I infer that this promise is the persuasive surface through which obstruction works. Alternatively, it may be one human analogue rather than the intended mode of the satanic action.

changed_reading.before: Satan privately makes bad deeds look pleasant and blocks isolated individuals.
changed_reading.after: The detour can be socially sold as a low-risk route: recruiters beautify it by promising to carry consequences they cannot transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear communication is followed by a command to travel and look, and later by a site from which a clear sign was deliberately left. The focus dwellings therefore become a field archive: material remains disclose only when an observer moves through them and reads their retained trace.

activation_trace.role: The inhabited-place branch anchors the archive in built and settled space.
The branch supplies disclosure of meaning by communication, establishing verbal clarity as one evidentiary channel.
Movement across land makes access to evidence an embodied itinerary rather than passive reception.
Directed sight or reflection supplies the active reading operation performed on the traveled landscape.
The branch supplies an effect that remains after departure, turning survival of the site into retained evidence.
Manifest clarity explicitly characterizes the retained sign immediately before the focus verse.

structural_cues: The sequence 29:18, 29:20, and 29:35 moves from clear delivery, to travel-and-look, to a deliberately retained clear sign just before 29:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies verbal disclosure, field movement, directed looking, and a retained clear trace; I infer that the preposition from in the focus marks evidence emerging from a material archive. The live alternative is simple visibility without an implied method of investigation.

changed_reading.before: The audience is merely told that the old dwellings make the story obvious.
changed_reading.after: The audience is positioned as a field reader whose travel and attention turn deliberately retained habitations into a legible archive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Shared false practice generates affection and connection among participants during worldly life; later the same network reverses into mutual repudiation and expulsion. Beautification can thus be socially produced by belonging: a deed feels good because it holds a group together.

activation_trace.role: The active production of an attractive surface anchors the affective recoding of shared deeds.
The branch supplies love and affection, the positive feeling that stabilizes the shared false practice.
The connective branch supplies a relation holding parties together, functioning as the practice's social infrastructure.
The branch supplies repudiation and disavowal, reversing the earlier bond.
Expulsion under anger gives the network's final reversal a social-spatial form.

structural_cues: 29:25 repeats بعضكم ببعض across a temporal reversal from affection between participants to mutual repudiation and cursing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present bonding and later reciprocal rupture; I infer that belonging is a medium that makes practices attractive and route-blocking. Alternatively, the affection may describe only an effect of the shared objects, not the causal vehicle of adornment.

changed_reading.before: Beautification is an optical or private psychological illusion.
changed_reading.after: Beautification can be affective infrastructure: group attachment rewards the deeds now and suppresses the route that would threaten belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people who cut the route and normalize the objectionable in their assembly are later described as having been turned away from the route. The two clauses form a feedback model: obstructing passage for others becomes a practiced disposition that leaves the obstructors unable to traverse rightly themselves.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies both self-turning and turning another, allowing obstruction to rebound upon its practitioners.
The focus route is the directional capacity eventually lost.
This branch specifically supplies road-cutting by seizure or repulsion, making active obstruction more than a generic severing.
The repeated traversable-route image creates the lexical hinge between what they cut and what they cannot follow.
The branch supplies the ugly or rejected act, locating route-cutting inside a publicly normalized practice.

structural_cues: 29:29 coordinates cutting the route with doing the objectionable in the club; 29:38 reuses the route noun with the group as object of obstruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated route language and opposite grammatical roles; I infer a moral feedback arrow from practiced obstruction to susceptibility to obstruction. A live alternative is that the two routes are only analogous and the reversal is rhetorical, not causal.

changed_reading.before: The groups are simply victims whom Satan blocks from an external path.
changed_reading.after: Their own culture of blocking passage helps build the disposition through which they themselves become blocked; victimhood and agency coexist.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, inhabitants end clinging motionless to the ground in their home; soon after, a constructed shelter is exposed as the weakest kind of house. Together they recode the focus dwellings as arrested motion and false security, not neutral architecture.

activation_trace.role: Cessation of movement within the dwelling root lets habitation carry the physical endpoint of immobilization.
The residential branch keeps that arrested endpoint tied to actual habitation.
The branch supplies adhering to the ground and remaining in place, freezing the inhabitants inside domestic space.
The shelter branch supplies the architecture whose apparent refuge is tested.
Loss of strength exposes settled shelter as structurally unable to secure its occupants.
The weaving creature supplies a made but fragile domestic structure, a material analogue for attractive yet failing works.

structural_cues: The focus is flanked by 29:37's bodies fixed in their home and 29:41's comparison of taken protectors to a weak house.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immobility, dwelling, construction, and weakness; I infer that the focus habitations embody a transition from apparent settlement to forensic arrest. Alternatively, the spider-house comparison may concern protectors without revising the earlier dwellings.

changed_reading.before: Their dwellings merely identify where past communities lived.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings are materialized arrested motion: what looked like stable shelter becomes the fragile mold in which a blocked life is frozen and exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear proofs coexist with self-exaltation, failed escape, seizure by each one's own offense, and self-directed wrong. Satanic adornment therefore does not displace agency: it operates through deeds owned by the subjects, especially prideful refusal of what is already manifest.

activation_trace.role: Purposive deeds remain theirs even when another agent beautifies them.
Available inner verification removes simple ignorance as a complete excuse.
Manifest proofs establish that refusal can occur after disclosure.
The branch supplies self-magnification and pride, a volitional posture that can neutralize evidence.
Failure to escape closes the imagined gap between chosen conduct and consequence.
The offense branch ties each differentiated outcome back to the subject's own culpable act.
Putting something outside its proper place supplies a self-disordering account of their wrong.

structural_cues: 29:39 binds clear proofs to arrogant response and failed outstripping; 29:40 repeats the subjects in the claim that they wronged themselves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, pride, owned offense, and reflexive wrongdoing; I infer a co-produced causal arrow in which adornment recruits their chosen posture. Alternatively, the satanic agent may remain primary, but the possessive and reflexive grammar still preserves accountability.

changed_reading.before: An external deceiver overpowers otherwise insightful people, potentially shifting blame away from them.
changed_reading.after: External adornment and self-authored culpability interlock: insight is present, pride consents, deeds remain theirs, and obstruction becomes self-wronging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies an inverse behavior-control system. In the focus, attractive deeds lead to blockage from the route; later, repeated worship restrains indecency, and exertion is answered by guidance into routes. Direction is stabilized through practice and responsive guidance, not by insight alone.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the harmful inhibition that turns agents away from the route.
The route image defines the directional capacity at stake.
One mapped inventory supplies the specified act of worship as the repeated practice that exerts protective restraint.
The alternate mapped inventory likewise supplies binding worship, making the practice mechanism robust across the split mapping.
The branch supplies active checking and restraint, the beneficial inverse of satanic blockage.
Expenditure of capacity under difficulty supplies the agent-side force that resists attractive drift.
Gentle indication toward route and truth supplies the responsive directional counterforce.
The route recurs in the plural as opened trajectories, reversing the focus's blocked singular route.

structural_cues: In 29:45 الصلاة is grammatically the restraining subject; in 29:69 human striving precedes the emphatic promise of guidance into سبلنا.
The focus has singular السبيل, while the closing response opens plural سبلنا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies practice-to-restraint and striving-to-guidance relations; I infer that they form a functional inverse to adornment-to-obstruction. They may instead be separate exhortations, so the control-system symmetry should remain an explanatory model rather than a formal equation.

changed_reading.before: The focus diagnoses a deception for which clearer perception would be the obvious remedy.
changed_reading.after: The diagnosis calls for counter-practices: disciplined restraint and costly striving keep insight behaviorally connected to traversable routes.

context_deltas.mechanism: People can answer correctly about the creator and still be turned from that answer's direction; at sea they become exclusive in allegiance, but after rescue on land they resume association. The focus discernment can therefore be real yet episodic, activated in crisis and unable to govern settled habit.

activation_trace.role: Inward knowledge anchors a lucidity that need not remain behaviorally sovereign.
Turning a thing away from its proper direction explains how a correct confession can fail to orient conduct.
Exclusive separation from association supplies the clarity reached under maritime danger.
Release by separation marks the transition from crisis to safety where the reversal occurs.
Association returns after rescue, showing the relapse of practice despite the preceding exclusive recognition.

structural_cues: 29:61 elicits the answer الله and immediately asks how they are turned; 29:65 places exclusive devotion in danger and renewed association directly after rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies correct speech, directional reversal, crisis exclusivity, and post-rescue relapse; I infer that مستبصرين can describe genuine but state-dependent lucidity. A live alternative is that the speakers in these scenes are not identical populations, so the sequence may illustrate a type rather than one psychology.

changed_reading.before: Being discerning is a stable trait that should have prevented deception.
changed_reading.after: Discernment may be acute yet episodic: it surfaces under pressure but loses control when safety restores attractive social habits.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because عَادًا is a proper name in the focus, not a command to return or an overt term for counting. It remains packet-anchored because that occurrence is explicitly split across return and counting inventories, while 29:19 supplies an actual return-after-beginning occurrence. Downstream prose should present this only as latent root-and-sound resonance that makes the catalog feel recurrent, never as the lexical translation or etymology of the tribal name.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The proper name عَادًا opens the focus's paired catalog and is mapped in the packet to both ع و د and ع د د inventories.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name branch secures the ordinary tribal referent and prevents the resonance from replacing it.
The split inventory's enumeration image makes the paired peoples feel like counted instances in a series.
Actual redoing after a beginning activates recurrence near the focus's proper name.
The non-dominant mapping adds recurrence at measured occasions, intensifying the counted-cycle resonance while remaining form-distant.

changed_reading.before: ʿĀd is solely the first item in a list of ancient peoples.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be a name, ʿĀd faintly activates a counted-return pattern: civilizations become repeatable instances of beginning, patterned deviation, and exposed aftermath.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The model is cross-domain and surprising because it activates the long-rope branch of ش ط ن and joins it to the later spider's woven house; neither image should replace the ordinary agent noun. It stays valid as a material analogy anchored in الشيطان, the route, and branch-backed web architecture. Downstream prose should mark it as an as-if topology of attachment, not as philological definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلشَّيْطَانُ ... فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ supplies an obstructing agent and a blocked route.

activation_trace.role: The long, tightly twisted rope supplies a tethering image for obstruction through attachment.
Adornment supplies the pleasant covering by which a tether can be mistaken for desirable belonging.
The traversable route is what tethered attachment prevents the subject from taking.
The weaving creature supplies the web-like architecture that catches while appearing to house.
Shelter gives the attachment its misleading appearance of security and belonging.
Structural weakness reveals that the apparent refuge is a trap incapable of bearing reliance.

changed_reading.before: Satan blocks the route by an unspecified act of persuasion.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, beautification weaves a tether that feels like shelter: attachment itself becomes the obstacle to departure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is morphologically distant because the focus has the form-X participle مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ, whereas the activated branch names protective armor; it must not be offered as a direct gloss. It remains anchored in the supplied ب ص ر inventory and gains mechanism from the weak-house comparison. Downstream prose should render only a secondary metaphor: they were as if cognitively armored, yet their chosen shelter could not protect them.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ is the focus word whose ب ص ر inventory includes a defensive-equipment branch.

activation_trace.role: The shield or armor branch supplies a defensive metaphor for confidence in one's own discernment.
The thick edge and joined-hide branch adds an image of cognition patched into a protective casing.
The shelter branch externalizes the protective structure with which the insight metaphor can be compared.
Loss of strength exposes the difference between feeling defended and possessing a sound support.

changed_reading.before: They possessed intellectual discernment but ignored it.
changed_reading.after: At a deliberately metaphorical edge, they may have felt armored by discernment while the attractive structure in which they trusted remained radically weak.

strongest_changes: The apparent paradox of discerning yet misdirected became a distinction between cognitive access and the practical valuation of deeds.
The dwellings became a deliberately retained field archive that transfers the role of observer from former inhabitants to present travelers.
Path obstruction became social and reciprocal: a detour can be marketed through false liability transfer, rewarded by group affection, and reinforced by blocking routes for others.
Later restraint, striving, and guidance supplied an inverse practice-loop to satanic adornment and obstruction.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly reactivated the focus's own directional and evidentiary roots while reversing roles: people cut a route and are then blocked from it; clear-sighted actors become material signs seen by others; singular blocked route becomes plural guided routes. The split mapping of عَادًا also preserved a carefully contained counted-return resonance that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ may denote possessed discernment, self-estimated cleverness, or active reflective seeing; the packet does not force one nuance.
The exact causal share of satanic agency, social mediation, and self-authored pride remains open even though the possessive and reflexive grammar preserves responsibility.
The return/count resonance in the proper name and the armor/tether images are branch-valid exploratory activations, not lexical translations, and require explicit qualification.
The material links among dwellings, immobilization, and the weak house may be deliberate architecture or an abductive cross-scene analogy.
